diagnostics: ℹ Very high reservoir fraction — excellent blooming potential
✓ Strong fabric substantivity — will last well on clothing
Blooming materials (Iso-E-effect): Patchouli EO, Patchouli EO, Ambrofix, Ambrofix, Romandolide
✓ >80% of formula mass is hedonically pleasant
Perceptual channels: 27 (11 cross-adaptation groups + 16 solo materials) from 39 ingredients
Channel model: 23 materials collapsed into 11 group channels (Laing ceiling applies to channels, not ingredients)
• ionone_family: Alpha Ionone, Beta Ionone, Alpha Irone, Methyl Ionone Pure, Dihydro Beta Ionone, Orivone (6 → 1 channel)
• musk: Ethylene Brassylate, Romandolide, Cashmeran (3 → 1 channel)
• woody_amber: Iso E Super, Timberol, Ebanol, Sandalore, Ambrofix (5 → 1 channel)
Genetic anosmia risk: 6.2% of formula mass affected by OR variants
⚠ OVERDOSED: Iso E Super (27.044%: flat, loses all other materials); Cashmeran (2.163%: overwhelming, sweet-chemical)
ℹ Near character-shift boundary: Cashmeran — small dose changes could shift perceived character
Far-field: Bergamot FCF, Linalyl Acetate, Geranium Flower EO
Mid-field: Lavender HA, Osmanthus Absolute, Beta Damascone, Hedione, Gamma Decalactone
Near-field: Rose de Mai Absolute, Sandalore, Labdanum Resinoid, Romandolide, Ethylene Brassylate

_diagnostics: BLOCKED_UNKNOWN_MATERIALS: Vetiver EO India; scorer did not assign generic fallback profiles
